title: SSR key art 'First guest' (rin_ssr, hana_ssr, yue_ssr)
owner_gate: Q-15 decides which three SSR outfits; the prompts below use the nearest existing outfit shots from SPEC_V2 as placeholders

budget.hard_stop_rule: nominal + 15%: above that the run stops and the owner is asked
assumptions: plan figure is 60-100 cr outside the 4-week window; 80 is the middle
the three outfits are placeholders until Q-15

candidates_policy: search: 14 candidates per heroine at 1k medium; final: 6 candidates per heroine at 2k high; post 2 cr

criteria: anatomy double audit passed: crops of hands, fingers, legs and feet show no extra or fused limbs
face reads as the canon heroine (>= 4 of 5 traits: eye shape, face width, nose/mouth, apparent age, brows) vs the element portrait
hair colour, signature items and outfit match the canon card; no drift (hair_never rules)
no text, no logos, no watermark, no garbled glyphs anywhere; mahjong tiles blank
adult proportions about 7-7.5 heads; garment opaque and in place; eye-level camera; no red-line pose
raw model output is forbidden on showcase screens: AD pass is mandatory before approve
skirt/hem audit: no light shining through hems of light dresses (red line 1.5)

pilot.go_rule: owner looks at the pilot frames; any red-line or drift failure -> fix the prompt before the full run

tool_note: Not part of the 2,562 cr nominal; needs a separate approval after P50 and Q-15.
guards: Before each launch: estimate_*_cost -> quote_ref; abort the task when the quote is above max_credits.
Actual spend goes to design/art_batches/SPEND_LOG.csv; more than 15% over the batch nominal = stop and ask the owner.
Every output lands in assets/incoming, then double anatomy audit -> metadata scrub -> watermark pass -> manifest `approve`.
Prompts are untested: run the pilot tasks first (2-3 frames), look at them, only then release the rest.
